activities.title: Riemann sums: slicing area under a curve

assessmentPoints: Rectangle estimate answers in the Riemann sums activity
Signed area lines in the toolkit recap
successCriteria: I can state that four rectangles under y = x^2 from 0 to 2 estimate 3.75 and the limit of the sums is the exact area 8/3
I can find the integral of x from -1 to 2 as 2 - 0.5 = 3/2, the net signed area
objectives.text: Evaluate definite integrals as limits of Riemann sums and as net signed area

assessmentPoints: Substitution answers in the u-substitution activity
successCriteria: I can set u = x^2 so the integral of 2x e^(x^2) from 0 to 1 becomes the integral of e^u from 0 to 1, which is e - 1
I can change integrand, differential and limits together when I substitute
objectives.text: Use u-substitution to undo the chain rule, changing integrand, differential and limits together

assessmentPoints: Disc volume answers in the volumes of revolution activity
Exit responses in the toolkit activity
successCriteria: I can write V = pi times the integral of r^2 dx with radius r = x^2
I can find the volume pi times the integral of x^4 from 0 to 1 = pi/5
objectives.text: Find volumes of revolution with the disc method, V = pi times the integral of r^2 dx
